metadata.title: What We Know About God
metadata.full_title: What Does the Bible Say About God?: What We Know About God — Foundational Facts, Biblically Backed
metadata.subtitle: Foundational Facts, Biblically Backed

days.title: Day 1: The Eternal, Triune God (Points 1–5)
days.subtitle: His Self-Existence, Omnipotence, Omniscience, Omnipresence & Triune Nature

points.short_label: Pt 1: He is Eternal
points.text: He is Eternal. He requires nothing, because He is completely self-sufficient and the source of all things. He has always been, and He will always be.

points.short_label: Pt 2: He is all-powerful (omnipotent)
points.text: He is all-powerful (omnipotent).

points.short_label: Pt 3: He knows everything (omniscient)
points.text: He knows everything (omniscient).

points.short_label: Pt 4: He is everywhere at all times (omnipresent)
points.text: He is everywhere at all times (omnipresent).

points.short_label: Pt 5: He is the Trinity (Father, Son, and…
points.text: He is the Trinity (Father, Son, and Holy Spirit).

review.title: Day 1 Personal & Family Bible Study Review: Knowing the Eternal Triune God

blocks.text: Open your Bible to **Psalm 90:2**, **Exodus 3:14**, **Deuteronomy 6:4**, and **Matthew 28:19** (or tap the verse links to read in the 365DBR Scripture Reader).

blocks.label: 1. Which attribute of God from Points 1–5 (Eternal, All-Powerful, All-Knowing, Everywhere-Present, or Triune) stood out most to you today, and how does it change how you view your current circumstances?
2. How do the Old Testament and New Testament together witness that the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit are the one true Eternal God (Deuteronomy 6:4; John 1:1, 14; Matthew 28:19)?

blocks.text: **Family & Personal Prayer:** Praise Yahweh as the Eternal, self-sufficient Creator who knows all things, holds all power, and is present with your household today.

days.title: Day 2: The Living Word, Perfect Love & Creator of Time (Points 6–10)
days.subtitle: Christ the Eternal Voice, Trinitarian Love, Creation by His Word & Relationship with Us

points.short_label: Pt 6: God is the Living Word, and the…
points.text: God is the Living Word, and the Word is God. Jesus Christ—the Son—is the literal "Voice" of God: He was present at the beginning, and it is through Him that the Father spoke the universe into existence. Today, He is the only Mediator and Advocate for us before the Father.

points.short_label: Pt 7: God is Love
points.text: God is Love. Because He exists eternally as the Trinity in perfect, self-giving fellowship, love is a foundational reality of the universe. Without God and His Word, there is zero biological or evolutionary reason for love to exist—mindless, coercive procreation is the animalistic default for survival, meaning sacrificial love and restraint would actually be a devolution from a purely secular perspective.

points.short_label: Pt 8: He created the universe by speaking it…
points.text: He created the universe by speaking it into existence. Whatever He speaks literally becomes reality, and because His very nature is Truth, He cannot lie.

points.short_label: Pt 9: He exists outside of time and space,…
points.text: He exists outside of time and space, and created them both as a framework for us to exist in. Nothing is required or needed by Him.

points.short_label: Pt 10: He created everything we know because He…
points.text: He created everything we know because He desired a personal relationship with us.

review.title: Day 2 Personal & Family Bible Study Review: The Living Word & The God of Love

blocks.text: Open your Bible to **John 1:1–3, 14**, **1 John 4:7–10**, **Genesis 1:1–3**, and **Titus 1:2**.

blocks.label: 1. Why is it impossible for true, self-giving love to originate from mindless evolutionary survival, and how does the eternal fellowship of the Trinity explain why love and personal relationship exist (Point 7 & Point 10)?
2. Because God spoke the universe into existence through Jesus Christ the Living Word and cannot lie (Point 6 & Point 8), why can we trust every promise He has spoken in Scripture?

blocks.text: **Family & Personal Prayer:** Thank the Father that through Jesus Christ our Mediator and Advocate, He created us not out of need, but out of love to walk in personal fellowship with Him.

days.title: Day 3: Free Will, Image Bearers, Life in the Womb & Biblical Marriage (Points 11–15)
days.subtitle: Moral Responsibility, Made in God's Image, Conception, Male & Female & The Indwelling Spirit

points.short_label: Pt 11: Because true love and a real relationship…
points.text: Because true love and a real relationship cannot be forced or pre-programmed, He did not create us as mindless robots; He gave us genuine free will—the capacity to choose to trust Him or reject Him. Because He is completely Holy and we are not, our choice to sin broke the world. The suffering, evil, and decay around us are entirely our fault, never His.

points.short_label: Pt 12: He created us in His image, breathing…
points.text: He created us in His image, breathing the breath of life directly into us. We are reflections of Him; anything good in us is from Him reflecting through us.

points.short_label: Pt 13: Our personal relationship with God begins in…
points.text: Our personal relationship with God begins in our mother’s womb. At the moment of conception, our unique DNA is established—we are not "potential" life, we are already fully human, known, and purposefully formed by Him.

points.short_label: Pt 14: He intentionally created us strictly male and…
points.text: He intentionally created us strictly male and female, and He authored marriage as the foundational building block of human family and society. Marriage belongs exclusively to God—it is a purely Biblical covenant designed to reflect Christ and His Church, and it makes zero logical or biological sense outside of a Scriptural perspective.

points.short_label: Pt 15: He wrote His moral law onto the…
points.text: He wrote His moral law onto the human heart, and He actively convicts the world of sin and truth through the Holy Spirit. In believers, the Holy Spirit literally indwells us—acting as our living conscience to separate good from evil, guiding us into all truth, and creating that unmistakable physical, emotional, psychological, and spiritual ache whenever we grieve Him by creating distance from God, His Word, and His Will.

review.title: Day 3 Personal & Family Bible Study Review: Created in God's Image for His Design

blocks.label: 1. How do Points 11–14 anchor the sanctity of human life from conception in the womb and God's exclusive authorship of marriage as strictly male and female?
2. How does the Holy Spirit work through our conscience when we create distance from God's Word, and how should we respond when we feel that spiritual conviction (Point 15; Psalm 51:8–12)?

blocks.text: **Family & Personal Prayer:** Ask the Lord to keep your heart tender to the conviction of the Holy Spirit and to help your household honor His design for life, family, and marriage.

days.title: Day 4: Our Humility Before God, Stewardship & The Infallible Word (Points 16–20)
days.subtitle: Human Limitation, Responsibility Over Creation, Our Need for Grace & How God Gave Scritpure

points.short_label: Pt 16: We are NOT God
points.text: We are NOT God. We do not possess anything on our own, have no power apart from what He gives us, and do not have His perspective.

points.short_label: Pt 17: We are extremely limited compared with God,…
points.text: We are extremely limited compared with God, but have always been set apart from the rest of the universe that He created for us.

points.short_label: Pt 18: We are responsible for the animals and…
points.text: We are responsible for the animals and the rest of His Creation. What happened in the Flood makes this extremely clear: our sin destroyed the earth and the animals as they were, right alongside us.

points.short_label: Pt 19: Apart from Him, we are fallible, sinners,…
points.text: Apart from Him, we are fallible, sinners, and liars by default.

points.short_label: Pt 20: It is His Word, transcribed by chosen…
points.text: It is His Word, transcribed by chosen men.

review.title: Day 4 Personal & Family Bible Study Review: Humble Stewards Under God's Word

blocks.text: Open your Bible to **Isaiah 55:8–9**, **Psalm 8:3–8**, **Romans 3:23**, and **2 Timothy 3:16**.

blocks.label: 1. Why is remembering that 'We are NOT God' (Point 16) and that apart from Him we are fallible sinners (Point 19) the essential starting point for true wisdom and humility?
2. How did our rebellion impact the rest of creation and the animals in the Flood (Point 18), and how did God faithfully preserve His spoken Word through chosen men (Point 20)?

blocks.text: **Family & Personal Prayer:** Confess your dependence upon God, thanking Him that even though we are limited and fallible, He gave us His infallible written Word.

days.title: Day 5: The Sufficiency of Scripture & The Very Good Creation (Points 21–25)
days.subtitle: Infallible Truth, Sufficiency, Humility of Heart vs. Pride & Pre-Fall Perfection

points.short_label: Pt 21: It is infallible, the source of ultimate…
points.text: It is infallible, the source of ultimate truth.

points.short_label: Pt 22: It contains everything mankind needs to know,…
points.text: It contains everything mankind needs to know, and nothing that it doesn’t.

points.short_label: Pt 23: It was written by Him for us,…
points.text: It was written by Him for us, and it begins at our beginning, as He has always been.

points.short_label: Pt 24: It can be understood by the simplest…
points.text: It can be understood by the simplest child, yet baffle a Rhodes Scholar; understanding His Word is a matter of the heart (soft and humble vs. hard and proud), not merely of the intellect.

points.short_label: Pt 25: The entirety of God’s Creation was “Very…
points.text: The entirety of God’s Creation was “Very Good” until the Fall. It operated in perfect harmony by His direct sustenance—light existed before the sun, mist rose from the ground without rain, and all humans and animals ate only plants.

review.title: Day 5 Personal & Family Bible Study Review: The Sufficiency of Scripture & Eden's Harmony

blocks.text: Open your Bible to **John 17:17**, **2 Timothy 3:15–17**, **1 Corinthians 1:18–25**, and **Genesis 1:29–31**.

blocks.label: 1. Why can a humble child understand the truth of God's Word while a proud scholar is baffled by it (Point 24; Matthew 11:25)?
2. What did God's 'Very Good' creation look like before the Fall (Point 25; 1 Timothy 4:4), and why is it vital to know that death and bloodshed were not part of God's original creation?

blocks.text: **Family & Personal Prayer:** Ask God to give every member of your household a soft, humble, teachable heart that trembles at His Word and trusts its complete sufficiency.

days.title: Day 6: The Fall, Entropy, Uncorrupted DNA & One Human Race (Points 26–30)
days.subtitle: Trusting God vs. a Lie, The Curse of Decay, Babel's Dispersion & One Blood

points.short_label: Pt 26: The original sin can be distilled to…
points.text: The original sin can be distilled to a simple choice and consequence: we trusted a liar over God’s Word. Unrepentant rejection of His Word for the lie is the unforgivable sin, and trusting His Word is the truth we must accept to be saved. "Apples" (we know it was a unique fruit, not a modern variety), serpents (Satan), blame, trees, and eating can all cause needless confusion if we allow them to distract from that core exercise of our free will—the choice to trust God or trust a lie.

points.short_label: Pt 27: Once we committed the original sin, the…
points.text: Once we committed the original sin, the consequence took effect: God placed creation under the Second Law of Thermodynamics (the law of entropy and the bondage of corruption), introducing death, pain, sorrow, painful toil, struggle, thorns, and the decay of all matter, including us.

points.short_label: Pt 28: Adam and Eve were perfect before the…
points.text: Adam and Eve were perfect before the Fall; their DNA was completely uncorrupted and contained all of the genetic information to produce the vast array of humans we see today.

points.short_label: Pt 29: There is only one biological race
points.text: There is only one biological race: the Human race, descending from Adam and later through Noah’s three sons. When post-Flood humanity rebelled against God's command to fill the earth by uniting in pride at Babel, God judged their rebellion by confusing their single language into distinct language families. As families dispersed and isolated across the globe, the rich genetic diversity already front-loaded into human DNA naturally sorted into the distinct physical traits and people groups we see today—proving that all people are one blood, and racism is both biblically and scientifically bankrupt.

points.short_label: Pt 30: God can make animals talk, but we…
points.text: God can make animals talk, but we are not merely talking animals.

review.title: Day 6 Personal & Family Bible Study Review: The Fall, Babel & One Human Race

blocks.label: 1. When stripped of distractions, what was the core choice at the root of the original sin (Point 26), and how did that choice bring the Second Law of Thermodynamics (entropy and decay) upon creation (Point 27)?
2. How do Adam and Eve's uncorrupted DNA and the dispersion at the Tower of Babel prove scientifically and biblically that there is only one biological human race—'one blood' (Points 28–30)?

blocks.text: **Family & Personal Prayer:** Thank God that He made all nations of one blood in His image, and ask for discernment to always trust His Word over the lies of the enemy.

days.title: Day 7: Genetic Entropy, Ancient Genius & Biblical Science (Points 31–35)
days.subtitle: Biological Devolution, The Intelligence of Early Man, Foundations of Science & God's Provision

points.short_label: Pt 31: We are not evolving
points.text: We are not evolving; we are devolving biologically and genetically along with everything else. Early humanity married close relatives with zero genetic harm because their DNA came uncorrupted from God's hand, whereas 2,500 years of accumulated post-Fall mutations required God to outlaw close-relative marriage in the Law of Moses—alongside the dramatic post-Flood drop in human lifespans.

points.short_label: Pt 32: We are not getting smarter
points.text: We are not getting smarter; we are standing on the shoulders of giants (accumulating recorded data while losing raw biological capacity). On Day 6, Adam immediately stepped into agronomy and comprehensive taxonomy—naming every kind of beast and bird; his first son built a city, and pre-Flood humanity mastered musical instrumentation and simultaneous bronze and iron metallurgy before Babel's megastructure engineering. Noah was smarter than Aristotle, Aristotle was smarter than Franklin, Franklin was smarter than Tesla, and Tesla was smarter than Elon.

points.short_label: Pt 33: Science, logic, and reason come from the…
points.text: Science, logic, and reason come from the Bible. Without an unchanging, rational Creator who upholds the universe by consistent laws—and who made our minds in His image—we would have no basis for reason, logic, science, knowledge, or understanding. True observational science aligns perfectly with the Bible.

points.short_label: Pt 34: Only God, the Cherubim, Adam, Eve, and…
points.text: Only God, the Cherubim, Adam, Eve, and the serpent (Satan) are recorded as having seen the Tree of Life and its fruit, or the Tree of the Knowledge of Good and Evil and its fruit. But all believers will see and partake of the Tree of Life one day.

points.short_label: Pt 35: Because we possess nothing on our own…
points.text: Because we possess nothing on our own and cannot reverse the consequence of sin or fix our own corruption, God provided the only possible solution Himself.

review.title: Day 7 Personal & Family Bible Study Review: True Science, History & Our Need for a Savior

blocks.label: 1. How do the biblical record of lifespans, the Law of Moses, and the immediate engineering and taxonomy skills of early humanity refute evolutionary progression and confirm genetic devolution (Points 31–32)?

2. Why do logic, reason, and observational science require the biblical Creator who upholds the universe by consistent laws (Point 33), and why could humanity never fix its own fallen condition (Point 35)?

blocks.text: **Family & Personal Prayer:** Praise the Lord that in Christ are hidden all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge, and thank Him for providing the salvation we could never earn.

days.title: Day 8: Jesus Christ the Last Adam, The Cross, Faith & New Creation (Points 36–40)
days.subtitle: The Incarnation, Sinless Obedience, Bodily Resurrection, Salvation by Faith & Eternal Restoration

points.short_label: Pt 36: The same Eternal Word who spoke the…
points.text: The same Eternal Word who spoke the universe into existence stepped into the framework of time and space He created, taking on human flesh as Jesus Christ, the Son of God.

points.short_label: Pt 37: Where the first Adam chose to trust…
points.text: Where the first Adam chose to trust a liar over God's Word—bringing sin, entropy, and death into the world—Jesus came as the Last Adam, living in perfect, sinless obedience to the Father's Word.

points.short_label: Pt 38: He willingly took the full consequence of…
points.text: He willingly took the full consequence of our choice upon Himself on the cross, shedding His blood to pay the debt of our sin, and conquered death by rising bodily from the grave on the third day.

points.short_label: Pt 39: Salvation is the exact reversal of our…
points.text: Salvation is the exact reversal of our original failure in the Garden: it is simply choosing to trust God's Word again—believing on the Lord Jesus Christ and receiving His free gift of righteousness by faith, not by our own effort.

points.short_label: Pt 40: One day soon, He will return to…
points.text: One day soon, He will return to abolish the curse completely. He will deliver all of creation from the bondage of entropy and corruption, raise believers with incorruptible, glorified bodies, and restore the unbroken fellowship of Eden forever in the New Heaven and New Earth.

review.title: Day 8 Personal & Family Bible Study Review: The Gospel Resolution & Eternal Restoration

blocks.text: Open your Bible to **John 1:14**, **1 Corinthians 15:3–4, 21–22**, **Ephesians 2:8–9**, **Romans 10:9–10, 17**, and **Revelation 21:1–5; 22:2–3**.

blocks.label: 1. How did Jesus Christ, as the Last Adam, reverse our original failure in the Garden through His sinless life, substitutionary death on the cross, and bodily resurrection (Points 36–39)?

2. Have you personally chosen to trust God's Word by believing on the Lord Jesus Christ for His free gift of righteousness (Point 39), and what excites you most about His promise to abolish the curse in the New Heaven and New Earth (Point 40)?

blocks.text: **Family & Personal Prayer:** Thank the Lord Jesus Christ for shedding His blood to pay our debt, rising bodily from the grave, and promising to return and restore unbroken fellowship forever.
